title: Moments Before Disaster
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 26, 2023, a police officer responded to a two-vehicle accident in Sparta, WI. The incident involved road rage, where a 55-year-old male confronted and physically engaged with the caller's son. The male exhibited signs of intoxication and was uncooperative with the officer upon arrival, leading to his arrest.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
